body.hypothesis: Out-of-time holdout: XNAS ITCH 2026-05-15 and 2026-05-18 (AAPL, MSFT, QQQ), never used for design or fitting; params, horizon, universe, cost model frozen as of the v1.7.2 tree. Fit/evidence base: 7 sessions 2019-01-30..2020-01-30. Confirmed iff leakage passes, gate IC has the registered sign and gate t >= the run's Bonferroni threshold (fresh ledger on the holdout dataset). Positive sign with t below threshold = 'weaker, not confirmed'. Statistical only; no P&L claim. PRIMARY. Microprice deviation predicts the 1s mid move (in-sample gate IC 0.105, t 21.1).
